title: Emrys and the Colony
author: Theo Sandoval
blurb: Ada Okonkwo, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
